tasks.title: Schema migration: device_keys table in both sqlite + mariadb
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/003-e2e-encryption-wire/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/schemas/device-key.json}. SECOND: add the device_keys table per Constitution Article XII (single-source migrations) — same DDL in BOTH internal/store/sqlite/ AND internal/store/mariadb/mariadb.go. Schema columns per REQ-211: key_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_imei TEXT NOT NULL, key_hash BLOB NOT NULL, key_hex_first_8 TEXT NOT NULL, algorithm TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked_at INTEGER. Plus two indexes: idx_device_keys_imei_active on (device_imei) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL; idx_device_keys_tenant on (tenant_id). Add Store interface methods: InsertDeviceKey(ctx, tenantID, key) + ListDeviceKeys(ctx, tenantID, imei) + RevokeDeviceKey(ctx, tenantID, imei, keyID) + GetActiveDeviceKeys(ctx, tenantID, imei) (returns newest-first). All methods take tenant_id as second param per Constitution Article IV.

tasks.title: Wire decryption into RockBLOCK + Cloudloop ingress — replace hardcoded encrypted=false
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/003-e2e-encryption-wire/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/asyncapi.yaml, acceptance/e2e-encryption.feature}. SECOND: in BOTH internal/rockblock/handler.go AND internal/cloudloop/webhook.go, find the place where WebhookMOMessage.Encrypted is currently set. (REQ-201) After body-decode + HMAC-verify (rockblock) or IP-allowlist (cloudloop) AND BEFORE decompression, IF keystore is non-nil AND len(rawBytes) >= 12+16 (nonce + tag minimum), try plaintext, _, err := h.keyStore.DecryptMessage(imei, rawBytes). (REQ-202) On success: set rawBytes = plaintext + encrypted := true + capture key_id used. (REQ-203) On error: leave rawBytes unchanged + encrypted := false (do NOT drop). (REQ-204) STOP setting encrypted := false unconditionally — the value MUST come from the decrypt step. (REQ-205) Both handlers must use the same logic. Update WebhookMOMessage + WebhookRawMessage Go structs to add key_id field. Add 5 new test scenarios covering happy path + no-key + bad-MAC + cloudloop-equivalent + key-rotation-grace.

tasks.title: REST API: POST + GET + DELETE /api/devices/{imei}/keys with tenant filter
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/003-e2e-encryption-wire/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/openapi.yaml, contracts/schemas/device-key.json, acceptance/e2e-encryption.feature}. SECOND: implement internal/api/device_keys.go exposing the three endpoints per contracts/openapi.yaml. (REQ-206 + REQ-207) POST returns DeviceKeyCreated with raw key_hex EXACTLY ONCE; subsequent reads omit it. (REQ-208) GET returns array per DeviceKey schema (no raw key). (REQ-209) DELETE sets revoked_at = now(). (REQ-210) Every endpoint extracts tenant_id from JWT, looks up device by (tenant_id, imei), returns 403 on cross-tenant access AND 404 on unknown device. (REQ-221) Use httpjson.ReadJSON for the POST even though body is empty — preserves the Article III invariant for future schema additions. Include @Summary/@Tags/@Router Swagger annotations.
